psychological_meaning: Bordeaux is a sophisticated and luxurious color, often associated with ambition, wealth, and power. It evokes feelings of confidence and stability, while also hinting at passion and creativity. Its depth suggests a sense of history and tradition.

real_world_examples.description: The classic color of a rich Bordeaux wine evokes feelings of luxury and tradition.

real_world_examples.title: Velvet Dress
real_world_examples.description: A bordeaux velvet dress exudes elegance and sophistication, making a bold fashion statement.

how_to_pair: Pair with gold for a luxurious feel.
Combine with cream for a softer, more inviting look.
Use with grey for a modern and sophisticated palette.
Contrast with teal for a vibrant and eye-catching design.
